hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error. The Planner explicitly instructed the investigation to cover both films, and while searching for 'Lo Zappatore' was part of the task, the WebSurfer agent completely ignored the necessity to search for 'Placer Sangriento' as a second, independent step. By repeating the 'Lo Zappatore' query instead of diversifying the search to the second film, the agent created a dependency loop where the Planner later accepted this singular focus as a partial success. This failure mode (ignoring the multi-part nature of the task) caused all subsequent steps (4, 6, 8, 13, 17, 19, 21) to redundantly search for the same film, preventing the data collection needed for the final comparison.
